_note: Hand-authored sample org for SkillPath Phase 1. The onet_soc field is normally
populated by the Phase 2 title->SOC matching step; here it is pre-filled so the
deterministic engine can be exercised without the LLM layer.
13-2099.01 (Financial Quantitative Analysts) stands in for the spec's headline
13-2051.00 (Financial and Investment Analysts), which has ZERO skill/knowledge
ratings in O*NET 30.3 and therefore has no vector. Same proxy tests/validate.py uses.
fin-analyst and fin-sr-analyst deliberately share a SOC: mapping both rungs to one
occupation is the correct real-world answer, and it exercises the engine's
fin-director maps to 11-1011.00 Chief Executives: O*NET has no Finance Director
occupation, and the broad executive code is the closest rated fit. Its ratings span
every industry, so a few of its deltas (Engineering and Technology, Transportation)
are artifacts of that breadth rather than real finance-career advice.
There is deliberately NO consulting/analytics rung (13-1111.00 Management Analysts).
Its absence is what the Phase 5 divergence flag is meant to surface.

roles.title: Accounts Payable Clerk
roles.description: Processes invoices and payments, maintains the ledger, reconciles vendor accounts.

roles.title: Financial Analyst
roles.description: Builds models, analyzes financial statements, supports budgeting and forecasting.

roles.title: Staff Accountant
roles.description: Prepares financial statements, runs the monthly close, supports external audit.

roles.title: Senior Financial Analyst
roles.description: Owns the forecasting model, leads business-partner reviews, mentors analysts.

roles.title: Finance Manager
roles.description: Runs the finance team, owns the budget cycle, manages headcount and planning.

roles.title: Finance Director
roles.description: Sets financial strategy, owns the P&L, reports to the executive team.
